text:
Ada: FYI saw a big perf blip during a mixed-family draft run (mistral -> mixtral draft). p99 jumped way up and KV invalidations spiked. Repro attached in PERF-1234.
Ben: Can you paste the bench profile and runtime config you used?

Ada: Paste below (minimal):
```
model: mistral-7b-v1
paired_draft: mixtral-7b-draft
kernel_selector: prefer=fused_attn_v2
seq_len: 256
batch_policy: continuous
avg_batch: 16
kv_hit: 0.92
spec_accept: 0.41
p50: 17ms
p95: 83ms
p99: 140ms
notes: frequent generic_kernel fallback token 1-4
```

Ada: Logs show head-dim mismatches and tokenizer reject events:
```
[warn] kv: head_dim_mismatch expected=64 got=80 session=abc123 -> invalidate
[debug] speculative: draft_reject tokenizer_mismatch token_idx=2
[info] kernel_selector: falling back to generic_kernel for small seqs
```

Carla: That head_dim mismatch screams cross-family pairing. Mixtral variants use a different kv layout; our optimized fused_attn_v2 assumes fixed head dims. When mismatches happen we either remap (not implemented everywhere) or drop to generic, which kills tail latency.

Dmitri: We flipped kernel_selector to prefer fused_attn_v2 last week for cost wins. It wasn't paired-tested across families. If pairing uses a draft from another family we should be conservative. Also tokenizer differences explain low early acceptance.

Ben: Two linked failure modes: eager fast-kernel selection + cross-family draft pairing -> low speculative acceptance and KV churn. If runtime acceptance_threshold > actual acceptance we abort drafts and do full decode. What were speculative and kv settings for the run?

Ada: From runtime/config used by bench job:
```
serve:
  kernel_selector:
    prefer: fused_attn_v2
    fallback: [fused_attn_v1, generic]
  speculative:
    acceptance_threshold: 0.6
    max_drafts: 2
  kv:
    compat: family_mapping
    mapping:
      mixtral: mistral-compat
```

Ben: With observed acceptance ~0.41 and threshold 0.6 the runtime will reject most drafts. That explains full-decode spikes.

Carla: Also tokenizer_mismatch indicates byte-level tokenization differences. Drafts from mixtral don't always align on early tokens, so acceptance is naturally lower. Pairing a draft with a different BPE/merges table is tough.

Erin: Proposed fixes: short-term and medium-term. Short-term: lower speculative.acceptance_threshold for mixed-family pairings (0.35), enable kv.compat=lenient to try cheap remap before invalidation. Medium-term: add KV remap kernel + tokenizer-normalizer for drafts and store tokenization fingerprint in model metadata so we can refuse/adjust pairings quickly.

Dmitri: I'll prototype a head-reshape remap kernel: if head_dim mismatch but total_kv_bytes match, do a reshape+transpose conversion. Should be ~1-2ms. Avoids generic fallback in many cases. Watch out for RoPE differences though.

Ada: Local prototype numbers: remap kernel added ~1.3ms per mismatch; p99 improved from 140ms -> 95ms. Combined with lowered acceptance threshold p99 -> ~74ms. Not baseline, but much closer.

Ben: Also update kernel_selector: when pairing.family != serving.family prefer conservative kernel order (fused_attn_v1 or generic) rather than v2. That reduces repeated invalidations.

Carla: Draft runtime config suggestion:
```
serve:
  kernel_selector:
    family_rules:
      - if pairing.family != serving.family:
          prefer: [fused_attn_v1, generic]
      - default:
          prefer: [fused_attn_v2, fused_attn_v1]
  speculative:
    acceptance_threshold:
      default: 0.6
      mixed_family: 0.35
  kv:
    compat: lenient
    remap_kernels: [head_reshape_v1]
```

Erin: Add a pairing-matrix test across Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen: record tokenization alignment, early-token acceptance, head/kv dims, RoPE scale diffs, and latency delta. Make it a nightly job and a prereq for kernel_selector changes.

Ada: Filed PERF-1234 with repro traces and bench output. Assigning to eng-runtime (Ben) and eng-ml (Dmitri). Prototype ETA 48h, canary rollout in ~1 week pending tests.

deploy-bot: rollout plan created for runtime-config patch -> canary eu-prod-1 20% traffic window 0300-0500 UTC auto-rollback on p99 > baseline+30% for 10m.

infra-bot: canary GPUs reserved (eu-prod-1) 4 nodes confirmed.

Ben: Action items: (1) lower mixed-family acceptance in canary, (2) enable kv.lenient + remap kernel, (3) add tokenization fingerprint check to pairing decision, (4) add pairing-matrix CI. I'll open the PR for conservative kernel order.

Carla: If you hit tokenizer mismatch often, paste raw input and both tokenizations (mistral vs mixtral). That helps heuristics.

Dmitri: Note: remapping must consider RoPE scaling differences (Llama-style RoPE vs Mixtral variants). We may need RoPE re-scaling when remapping KV to avoid attention phase drift. I'll instrument phase error logs.

Ada: Good catch. I'll add a RoPE check to remap kernel and log if phase deviation > 2%.

Ben: Great. If canary metrics look stable we roll to 100% per rollout policy. @Carla please own the pairing-matrix CI.

Carla: On it. Nightly job + initial matrix tomorrow AM.

Ada: Re-queued bench with remap prototype, will post numbers in ~2h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ben: +1

infra-bot: PERF-1234 assigned to ben,dmitri,carla,ada
